items.title: UBS Hires 3 Financial Advisor Teams With $2.6 Billion in Client Assets
items.summary: UBS  has recruited a trio of financial advisor teams managing around $2.65 billion in client assets.  The teams joined UBS on Friday, according to registration records.  The Mason Cisney Alcon Wealth Management Group, based in Pueblo, Colo., managed $1.4 billion at  Morgan Stanley  and produced annual revenue of more than $3.5 million.
